item.title: Can you identify 10 games I've turned into pixelated messes?
item.content:encoded: It's time to find out how low res we can go.

item.title: Gaussian Splatting is my new favourite thing, so I hassled an ex-Epic artist to tell me everything he knows about the low-cost 'photo-real' rendering technique
item.content:encoded: "It is not just a rendering trick—it changes the entire capture-to-delivery pipeline."

item.title: Europa Universalis 5's 'biggest update yet' expands the Balkans, overhauls the economy, and fixes more than 2,000 bugs
item.content:encoded: The Encinades update also reworks orthodoxy and improves military systems.

item.title: Abiotic Factor just got another massive update that adds better pets, a ludicrously involved chemistry system, and most importantly, a mop for cleaning up all your failed experiments
item.content:encoded: Cosmic Companions is live now.

item.title: This very normal Half-Life mod lets you play as 'queen of spacetime' Max Caulfield, and it's convinced me that the next Life is Strange should be a full-on boomer shooter
item.content:encoded: Half-Life is Strange adds rewind powers and teen angst into Valve's FPS.

item.title: Conan Exiles whips out a massive Unreal Engine 5 upgrade that includes an 'enhanced endowment slider' to further improve player penises
item.content:encoded: Biggus Clickus.

item.title: Immediately after putting The Elder Scrolls in Fallout 4, hero modder gets Fallout 1 working on the Pip-Boy too: 'This was so heavily requested, I couldn't pass it up'
item.content:encoded: Just get the whole series on there, I guess.

item.title: Nobody believes Blizzard meant to give Diablo 4: Lord of Hatred players a 900% gold boost, but that hasn't stopped them from exploiting it until someone sticks a decimal point in there
item.content:encoded: Get rich with this one easy trick.

item.title: Morrowind mega-mod Skywind looks so good, even if it's still not finished
item.content:encoded: The effort to bring Morrowind into Skyrim continues, and—as always—the team could use some help.

item.title: Anticipated supercannon sim PVKK delayed until 2027, but for the kind of reason you want to hear
item.content:encoded: This just gives us more time to weigh the ethical implications of operating giant weaponry for the baddies.

item.title: GTA 6's multi-billion-dollar budget is 'a high-stakes game for big boys only,' Take-Two boss says, but he's 'cool with it'
item.content:encoded: That's one way of putting it.

item.title: Sony Interactive Entertainment chief says AI will enable 'gaming experiences like never before,' and I wonder: How long are these guys going to talk about it before we actually start seeing it?
item.content:encoded: And do we really want that anyway? I'm not so sure I do.

item.title: Update: Discord says it's 'seeing significant recovery' after a partial outage
item.content:encoded: If you can't start up Discord, it's not just you.

item.title: Arrowhead addresses the Helldivers 2 community as recent Steam reviews slump to Mostly Negative: 'We want to be clearer about what we're working on and what's coming next'
item.content:encoded: Multi-week campaigns, new vehicles, and more red stratagems are all apparently in the works.

item.title: Microsoft might be all-in on OpenAI now, but back in 2018 thought it was just 'motivated by a need to show how Al can crush humans'
item.content:encoded: "We don't want 'machines beating humans' and are not supportive of any push on this."

item.title: Brigador Killers smacked me in the mouth by making me level a city and kill the protagonists of the first game, and I can't wait for more
item.content:encoded: Hardcore.

item.title: True permadeath: You can never play this game again if you let its immortal snail assassin touch your mouse pointer
item.content:encoded: The meme where a killer snail slowly but relentlessly pursues you is coming to your desktop.

item.title: Elo Shapes reveals a speedy gaming mouse from a fresh new brand that weighs even less than the competition
item.content:encoded: Speeding into view.

item.title: 2K Games confirms layoffs at Project Ethos shooter studio and hints at new design direction: 'It's become clear that changes need to be made'
item.content:encoded: The free-to-play extraction/hero shooter was announced in 2024, but hasn't made much headway since.

item.title: If you're wondering where all the storage is going, it's landed in this 245 TB data center SSD from Micron
item.content:encoded: How's your 1 TB HDD feeling now?

item.title: CCP changed its name rather than pick a fight with the Chinese Communist Party, which was probably wise
item.content:encoded: The EVE dev just has fewer armoured divisions, is all.

item.title: Final Fantasy 14's newest expansion name almost broke the series' 12-year tradition as Yoshi-P 'really wanted' his original idea
item.content:encoded: Evercold could have been called something totally different.

item.title: Rockstar ransom hackers claim to have stolen the data of 280 million teachers, school staff, and students in Canvas attack
item.content:encoded: Lock it down, switch on 2FA, and stay safe, folks.

item.title: Resident Evil Requiem just shadow-dropped a bonus roguelike mode, and it's absolutely fantastic
item.content:encoded: Unfortunately, Leon Must Die Forever.

item.title: Nvidia RTX 5050 review (Palit Dual edition)
item.content:encoded: The best budget GPU, though it pains me to say so.

item.title: Valve forming an orderly queue for the Steam Controller makes it clear we need the same for the Steam Machine, Frame, and perhaps a lot more in-demand tech too
item.content:encoded: We need a better system.

item.title: Chrome is installing a 4 GB local AI model on some of your PCs without asking for permission and will just download it again if you delete it
item.content:encoded: 'Chrome did not ask. Chrome does not surface it. If the user deletes it, Chrome re-downloads it.'

item.title: Videogame 'beta versions' are anything but, says veteran RPG dev—real games are 'sh***y, sh***y, sh***y, sh***y, slightly less sh***y, and it skyrockets' at the end
item.content:encoded: Better betas, but better.

item.title: 'Pearl Abyss created 5,000,000 amateur ornithologists with one update': Crimson Desert's latest patches have effectively transformed it into a birdwatching simulator
item.content:encoded: Wait, is that a rare owl?? Sick.

item.title: Nvidia's VP of deep learning says AI workers are already 'far beyond the costs of the employees'
item.content:encoded: How much will AI workers really cost in the end?

item.title: Sony records a $766 million impairment loss against Bungie for the 2025 financial year, a 1-2 punch of Destiny 2 and Marathon failing to meet its expectations
item.content:encoded: Sony bought Bungie for $3.6 billion in 2022.

item.title: Everything is Crab review
item.content:encoded: Survival of the fittest—or at least the most over-levelled.

item.title: All Genshin Impact 6.6 livestream codes
item.content:encoded: Grab the Primogems for the Luna 7 special program.

item.title: 'Regardless of the type of offer, available capacity is essentially zero right now': SK hynix is reportedly being swamped with 'unprecedented' offers to secure memory chips
item.content:encoded: And it seems like it won't slow down for a while.

item.title: Andy Serkis says 'there has always been that snobbery' when it comes to videogame acting, but the times are changing thanks to games like Expedition 33
item.content:encoded: "I don't see any difference between that and acting in films or on stage or TV."

item.title: Microsoft exec. confirms Windows 11 is just as full of old code as you suspected: 'We were thinking flying cars and moon stations by the year 2026, not Win32'
item.content:encoded: "Did anyone in the '90s expect Win32 to still be a first-class API surface in the year 2026? And I think I can safely answer, no."

item.title: Even seven-year-old GPUs will be able to run Subnautica 2, according to its latest system requirements
item.content:encoded: And launch is only a week out.

item.title: Nintendo is raising the price of the Switch 2 later this year
item.content:encoded: A $50 increase in the US. Further increases rolling out in Japan, Europe, and Canada.

item.title: '90s virtual reality, Battlefield 2142, and Total War: This month in PC Gamer 10, 20, and 30 years ago
item.content:encoded: Here's what was happening in PC gaming in May 1996, May 2006, and May 2016.

item.title: The producer of the new Mortal Kombat film is annoyed that film reviewers are appraising it as a film
item.content:encoded: This is not a game.

item.title: Indie publisher New Blood has listened to over 1,000 voicemails left on its old-school tip line, including suggestions like 'you ever think about making a game where you fight bugs?'
GameStop-eBay saga gets weirder: CEO says he was suspended from eBay for selling stuff on eBay 'to pay for eBay'
item.content:encoded: Maybe all of this really is just a very dumb, pointless stunt.

item.title: Path of Exile 2's 'biggest expansion ever' reworks its entire post-campaign grind for new and returning players alike
item.content:encoded: Several new quests will walk you through its endless endgame experience.

item.title: Path of Exile 2's massive Return of the Ancients expansion will be its last major update before it leaves early access later this year: 'I want to get this game finished, I really, really do'
item.content:encoded: Game director Jonathan Rogers says the endgame rework needed to happen for the game to feel complete enough to release.

item.title: One guy broke 2 different Fallout 4 speedrun world records 9 times in 2 months
item.content:encoded: Fastest Mario.

item.content:encoded: "I picked up the hammer, stuck on Frankie goes to Hollywood's Two Tribes, got myself psyched up and went outside."

item.title: The artist who created 40 in-game paintings for Minecraft did one of Jack Black as Steve for Minecraft Movie 2, and it's pretty fantastic
item.content:encoded: The sequel has started filming in New Zealand.
